description: Full single-file Tetris: 7 tetrominoes with SRS rotation and wall kicks, hold slot, 5-piece next queue, ghost piece, soft/hard drop, lock delay, line-clear scoring with combos, level speed curve, pause, game over and localStorage high score.

criteria: tetris_model_01.html is one self-contained Tetris (no libraries): the 7 tetrominoes with correct shapes, SRS rotation and wall-kick tests, hold with once-per-piece lock, a visible next queue of at least 5 pieces, ghost preview, soft and hard drop, lock delay, line clears with gravity of stacked lines, standard scoring with combo and back-to-back bonuses, a level curve that speeds up gravity, pause and restart, game-over detection, and a persisted high score in localStorage. No fake line clears or predetermined boards.
